idea.title: The shop that sells a hundred brands
idea.one_line: A multi-brand shop owner smells SYNOR cold, on camera, with his own shelf behind him.
idea.why_it_works: He has a hundred reasons to be unimpressed and nothing to gain by being kind, so whatever he says lands harder than anything we could say about ourselves.
idea.who_for: Anyone who assumes a ₹49 tester means a cheap perfume

concept.where: a multi-brand perfume shop in a busy market, Ahmedabad
kit: 3ml testers, twenty of them, in a bag he can keep
Paper smelling strips, a dozen — never spray on his stock or his counter
Phone, and a collar mic if there is one; a market is loud
A small notebook to write his shop name and handle down correctly
concept.shoot_notes: Go at a dead hour, not when customers are in. Praise only what is actually true about the shop, and ask him on camera whether he wants it named and tagged — his shop being seen is the only thing he gets out of this, so give it to him properly. If he says no to the camera, buy something small and leave; there is another shop. And record long: you will keep the phone running for five to ten minutes of him talking and use about thirty seconds of it. Shots 5, 8 and 9 are all cut out of that one recording, so do not stop and restart between questions.

hook.spoken: Is bhai ke paas sau brand hain. Aaj mera sunghega.

people.who: the owner of the shop, who sells a hundred other brands
people.consent: Bhai, main SYNOR se hoon, apna perfume banata hoon. Ek video bana raha hoon Instagram ke liye aur aapka sach-sach review chahiye, achha ho ya kharaab. Aapki dukaan ka naam bhi daal doonga. Theek hai?
people.disclosure: Maine unhe sirf testers diye, review unka apna hai.
questions: Sungh ke sabse pehle kya laga aapko
Aapke counter par is type ka kya chalta hai aaj kal
Ismein aapko kya kharaab lagta hai
Aapke hisaab se ye kitne ka hona chahiye
Aap ise apne customer ko dena chahenge ya nahi, aur kyun
listen_for: Whatever number he says when he guesses the price — that is the video, high or low
The word he reaches for first, before he has thought about it
Any comparison to what he stocks, so long as he says no brand name
A flat, bored or unimpressed answer — keep it in, it is worth more than a warm one
Whether he asks for testers himself, unprompted
Anything he says about the 30% oil once he has smelled it on skin
people.closing_if_warm: Bahar aa gaya. Sach kahoon to andar jaate waqt dhadkan tez thi. Ek aadmi jo sau brand bechta hai, usne mera perfume sungha aur khud bola ki ______. Mujhe andar se shaanti mili. Aur unhone tester bhi rakh liye, maine mange nahi the — unka confidence dekh ke mera bhi aa gaya.
people.closing_if_cold: Bahar aa gaya. Sach bataun, jo socha tha wo nahi hua. Unhone kaha ki ______, aur wo galat nahi hai. Sunna achha nahi laga, par isi liye to pucha tha. Ye video main isliye daal raha hoon ki agar main sirf tareef wale video daalunga, to aap kabhi yakeen nahi karoge. Aap khud sungh ke batao.

shots.visual: Walking towards the shop, phone low, the board coming into frame
shots.spoken: Is bhai ke paas sau brand hain. Aaj mera sunghega.

shots.visual: The shelf wall, panning across it, no single brand held in frame
shots.spoken: Is area mein ye dukaan sabse purani hai.

shots.visual: Him behind the counter, looking at the camera, being asked
shots.spoken: Aapka sach-sach review chahiye, achha ho ya kharaab.

shots.visual: A paper strip sprayed and handed across the counter
shots.spoken: SYNOR Ocean Verve. Tees percent oil hai ismein.

shots.visual: His face while he smells it, and his first answer. Do not cut away and do not talk over him
Second strip, his hand taking it
shots.spoken: Ye SYNOR Royal Oud hai. Sardi ke liye.

shots.visual: Third strip, and him holding all three fanned out
shots.spoken: SYNOR Velvet Heels. Ye ladies ke liye hai.

shots.visual: Him answering the price question, hands still holding the strips
Him answering what he does not like. Hold on him even if it is uncomfortable
The bag of testers going down on his counter, his hand reaching
shots.spoken: Maine unhe sirf testers diye, review unka apna hai.

shots.visual: Outside on the street, selfie camera, shop still behind the shoulder
shots.spoken: Sabko pasand nahi aayega, Royal Oud bahut bhaari hai.

shots.visual: A 3ml tester held up between two fingers, nothing else in frame
shots.spoken: Tester sirf ₹49, aur wahi ₹49 bottle par wapas.

honest_negative: Sabko pasand nahi aayega, Royal Oud bahut bhaari hai.
b_roll: His hands opening and closing a tester cap
The shelf from low down, out of focus, so no label reads
The street outside the shop, people walking past
The bag of testers sitting on the counter after he has taken it
caption: Ek dukaan jahan sau brand bikte hain. Wahan apna perfume le gaya aur pucha ki sach bataiye. Jo unhone kaha, bina kaanchi ke daala hai.
youtube_title: I took my perfume to a shop that sells 100 brands
youtube_description: A shop owner with a hundred brands on his shelf smelled ours cold, on camera, and said what he thought. Nothing was scripted and nothing was cut for being unkind. He kept some testers; that is said in the video. synorperfume.com/products/synor-ocean-verve-extrait-de-parfum-copy synorperfume.com/products/synor-royal-oud-extrait-de-parfum synorperfume.com/products/synor-velvet-heels-extrait-de-parfum
thumbnail: His face mid-smell, strip at his nose, shelf blurred behind. Text: HUNDRED BRANDS, ONE VERDICT
diaries_tie_in: Becomes a Diaries entry on what somebody who sells perfume all day notices in the first four seconds, and what he does not care about at all.

lines: Is bhai ke paas sau brand hain. Aaj mera sunghega.
Main andar ja raha hoon. Pata nahi kya bolega.
script.note: Two lines and no more. Anything else here kills the hook.

script.scene: Inside, at the counter — the asking
script.camera: low, not on his face yet
lines: Namaste bhai.
Bhai, main SYNOR se hoon, apna perfume banata hoon. Ek video bana raha hoon Instagram ke liye aur aapka sach-sach review chahiye, achha ho ya kharaab. Aapki dukaan ka naam bhi daal doonga. Theek hai?
Thank you bhai. Do minute lagenge, bas.
script.their_turn: Yes or no. Only go on after a yes — a no means buy something small and leave, there is another shop.
script.note: Recorded whether or not it reaches the cut. Shot 3 is clipped out of the middle of the long line.

script.camera: panning the shelf, no single label held in frame
lines: Is area mein ye dukaan sabse purani hai.
Bhai aapki dukaan kitne saal se hai?
Sau se zyada brand rakhte ho na aap?
Isi liye aapke paas aaya hoon. Aap din bhar perfume sunghte ho, aapko turant pata chal jaata hai.
script.their_turn: How old the shop is, how many brands he carries.
script.note: Say only what is true. If it is not the oldest, say what it is — most variety, people come from far. False praise is heard as false.

lines: Ye dekho. SYNOR Ocean Verve. Tees percent oil hai ismein.
Strip pe daal raha hoon, aapke stock pe nahi.
Sungh ke sabse pehle kya laga aapko?
script.their_turn: His first reaction, unprompted. This is shot 5.
script.note: The line about not spraying his stock matters more than it looks — he is guarding his shelf until he hears it.

script.camera: the strips, him holding all three
lines: Ye SYNOR Royal Oud hai. Sardi ke liye.
SYNOR Velvet Heels. Ye ladies ke liye hai.
Aapke counter par is type ka kya chalta hai aaj kal?
script.their_turn: What sells at his counter now. Let him talk about his own shop; he is more honest about ours afterwards.

script.camera: his face, still, no cutting away
lines: Bhai ek baat sach batao. Ismein aapko kya kharaab lagta hai?
Nahi bhai, sach bolo. Mujhe wahi sunna hai. Tareef to sab karte hain.
Aapke hisaab se ye kitne ka hona chahiye?
Aur aap ise apne customer ko dena chahenge ya nahi? Kyun?
script.their_turn: The criticism (shot 9), the price guess (shot 8), and whether he would stock it.
script.note: Ask the second line only if the first gets 'sab achha hai'. Ask it once. A third time is fishing, and the camera shows it.

script.camera: the counter, the bag, his hand
lines: Bhai, ye bees tester chhod raha hoon aapke paas. Customer ko sungha dena, koi paisa nahi.
Maine unhe sirf testers diye, review unka apna hai.
script.their_turn: He may ask how many he can have. If he asks first, that is the better ending — use it.
script.note: The second line stays in the cut. Not optional.

script.camera: selfie, the shop over your shoulder
lines: Sabko pasand nahi aayega, Royal Oud bahut bhaari hai.
Tester sirf ₹49, aur wahi ₹49 bottle par wapas.
script.note: Which closing you speak depends on what he said; both are below. Film it while still outside his shop, before the feeling wears off.
